title: An unrecoverable error settles the task at TASK_STATE_FAILED
rationale: A failed turn is a TASK STATE, not a transport error: the work failed, the protocol did not. The client therefore handles ONE shape of ending rather than two, and the terminal-close rule of specification section 11.7 ends the stream exactly as a success would. The reason travels on the status message so a client learns what went wrong without a second call, and no artifact is published, because a turn that failed produced no output to publish.
